quests.instruction: Mia pulls something over her head and pushes her arms through the sleeves. What is she putting on?
quests.hint: It covers the top half of your body.
quests.explanation: A shirt covers your chest, back, and usually your arms. Pants and socks go on the bottom half.
quests.funFact: Many shirts have a small tag inside the neck that tells you the size and how to wash it.

quests.instruction: Omar puts one leg into each side of his clothes and pulls them up to his waist. What is he wearing?
quests.hint: Remember where each leg goes.
quests.explanation: Pants have two leg tubes, one for each leg. That is why you step into them instead of pulling them over your head.
quests.funFact: Long pants are sometimes called trousers.

quests.instruction: Ana is ready to walk to the park. What goes on her feet?
quests.hint: You need them before you step outside.
quests.explanation: Shoes cover and protect your feet when you walk on the ground.
quests.funFact: Most shoes come in pairs: one for the left foot and one for the right.

quests.instruction: Ravi is looking for short pants that stop above the knees. Which one should he choose?
quests.hint: They leave the knees uncovered.
quests.explanation: Shorts are short pants. They stop above the knee, which keeps legs cool.
quests.funFact: The word 'shorts' is always plural, like 'pants' and 'scissors'.

quests.instruction: One piece of clothing covers the top of the body and hangs down below the waist, all joined together. What is it?
quests.hint: Look for the one that is a top and a bottom in one.
quests.explanation: A dress is one piece that joins a top and a skirt part. A skirt has only the bottom part.
quests.funFact: People of all ages and many cultures wear dresses and long robes.

quests.instruction: Zoe wants something that hangs from her waist but has no separate leg parts. What does she choose?
quests.hint: Shorts and pants both have two leg parts.
quests.explanation: A skirt hangs from the waist like an open tube. It has no separate legs, which makes it easy to move in.
quests.funFact: Skirts can be short, knee-length, or long enough to reach the ankles.

quests.instruction: Noor wants something soft to put on her feet before her shoes. What does she pick?
quests.hint: They sit between your foot and your shoe.
quests.explanation: Socks go on first. They cushion your feet and make shoes more comfortable.
quests.funFact: Socks wear out at the heel and toes first because those parts rub the most.

quests.instruction: Which footwear is tall enough to cover the ankle?
quests.hint: Look for the one that reaches up past the foot.
quests.explanation: Boots go up around the ankle, and some go higher. That gives extra coverage compared with most shoes.
quests.funFact: Hiking boots often have thick soles with bumpy patterns for grip.

quests.instruction: Kai wants open shoes with straps so his toes can feel the air on a warm day. Which pair fits?
quests.hint: Think about shoes that leave part of the foot uncovered.
quests.explanation: Sandals have straps and open sides, so air moves around your feet and keeps them cool.
quests.funFact: Sandals are one of the oldest kinds of footwear people have made.

quests.instruction: Priya wants something to shade her face from the bright sun. What does she put on?
quests.hint: It goes on your head.
quests.explanation: A hat sits on your head. A hat with a brim makes shade for your face.
quests.funFact: A hat with a wide brim shades your ears and neck too.

quests.instruction: Leo wraps a long strip of soft cloth around his neck to stay warm. What is it?
quests.hint: It goes around your neck, not your waist.
quests.explanation: A scarf wraps around the neck and helps keep out cold air.
quests.funFact: Scarves can be wrapped, tied, or looped, so you can wear them in different ways.

quests.instruction: Which clothing has a separate place for each of your fingers?
quests.hint: Count the tubes inside.
quests.explanation: Gloves have one narrow tube for each finger, so you can still pick things up while your hands stay covered.
quests.funFact: A pair of gloves is made as a left glove and a right glove.

quests.instruction: It is snowing and Tariq needs the thickest top layer to wear outside. What should he choose?
quests.hint: Think about the warmest top on this list.
quests.explanation: A coat is thick and made for cold weather. A shirt is thin, and shorts go on the legs.
quests.funFact: Many winter coats have a soft lining inside to trap warm air.

quests.instruction: Which soft, knitted top pulls on over your head and keeps you cozy indoors?
quests.hint: Knitted means made from looped yarn.
quests.explanation: A sweater is knitted from yarn. The loops hold warm air near your body.
quests.funFact: Sweaters are often made of wool or cotton yarn.

quests.instruction: Sam wants a light layer that zips up the front for a cool, breezy day. Which is best?
quests.hint: Look for the one with a zipper.
quests.explanation: A jacket is lighter than a winter coat and often zips up the front. It blocks a cool breeze.
quests.funFact: A zipper has tiny teeth that lock together when the zipper pull slides up.

quests.instruction: Zoya brushes her teeth and gets ready for bed. What does she change into?
quests.hint: These are made for sleeping.
quests.explanation: Pajamas are soft and comfortable, so they are made for resting at night.
quests.funFact: Pajamas got their name from a word for loose, light trousers in South Asia.

quests.instruction: Diego is going swimming at the pool. Which clothing is made to get wet?
quests.hint: Consider what dries quickly.
quests.explanation: A swimsuit is made from light fabric that dries fast, so it works well in and around water.
quests.funFact: Swimsuits are usually made from stretchy fabric that moves with you.

quests.instruction: Some schools ask all children to wear the same style of clothes. What are these clothes called?
quests.hint: Everyone in the group wears a matching set.
quests.explanation: A uniform is a set of clothes that members of a school or team wear in the same style.
quests.funFact: Many sports teams use uniforms so players can tell teammates apart quickly.

quests.instruction: Which pants are usually made of strong blue fabric called denim?
quests.hint: Denim is thick and sturdy.
quests.explanation: Jeans are made of denim, a strong cotton fabric that lasts a long time during play.
quests.funFact: Denim gets its strength from threads woven tightly together.

quests.instruction: Mei wants pants that stretch and fit close to her legs for dancing. Which does she pick?
quests.hint: Focus on which one stretches the most.
quests.explanation: Leggings are stretchy and fit snugly, so they move easily when you bend, jump, or dance.
quests.funFact: Stretchy clothes often have a little elastic thread woven into the fabric.

quests.instruction: Ben wants a long-sleeved top that pulls on over the head and has a hood. What is it?
quests.hint: The clue is in the name.
quests.explanation: A hoodie has a hood that can cover your head. A plain sweater does not have one.
quests.funFact: The 'hood' in hoodie is the part that pulls up over your head.

quests.instruction: Which coat is made so that rain slides off it?
quests.hint: Water should not soak in.
quests.explanation: A raincoat has a smooth, waterproof surface. Rain runs off instead of soaking through.
quests.funFact: Raincoats are often bright yellow, so people can see you in grey, rainy weather.

quests.instruction: Mei wants to jump in puddles and keep her feet dry. Which footwear should she wear?
quests.hint: Think about what keeps water out.
quests.explanation: Rain boots are waterproof and tall, so puddle water stays outside.
quests.funFact: Rain boots are often made of rubber, which water cannot soak into.

quests.instruction: Which loose rain cover pulls over your head and hangs down over your body?
quests.hint: It has a hole for your head.
quests.explanation: A poncho slips over your head and hangs loosely, so it covers your whole upper body.
quests.funFact: A poncho has no sleeves, so it is quick to put on.

quests.instruction: Which item goes around the waist to hold pants in place?
quests.hint: It goes through loops on the pants.
quests.explanation: A belt wraps around your waist and keeps pants from slipping down.
quests.funFact: Belt loops are the small strips of fabric on pants that the belt slides through.

quests.instruction: Sana is painting at school. What can she wear to keep her clothes clean?
quests.hint: It covers the front of your clothes.
quests.explanation: An apron covers your clothes, so paint or food lands on the apron instead.
quests.funFact: Aprons often have a pocket in front for tools or brushes.

quests.instruction: Which layer covers the chest and back but leaves the arms free?
quests.hint: Look at the arms.
quests.explanation: A vest has no sleeves, so it keeps your body warm while your arms move freely.
quests.funFact: Vests are good for keeping your middle warm without making your arms too hot.

quests.instruction: Jeans, shorts, and leggings all cover the legs. Which other item belongs with them?
quests.hint: Think about the group name: bottoms.
quests.explanation: Pants cover the legs, just like jeans, shorts, and leggings. These are all called bottoms.
quests.funFact: Clothes for the legs are sometimes called 'bottoms' and clothes for the chest 'tops'.

quests.instruction: T-shirt, sweater, and hoodie all go on the upper body. Which other item belongs with them?
quests.hint: They all cover the chest and arms.
quests.explanation: A jacket covers the chest and arms too. Sandals go on the feet and shorts go on the legs.
quests.funFact: Clothes you wear on top of another top are called outer layers.

quests.instruction: Lina is packing for a day at school. Which pair of items goes on her feet?
quests.hint: Both items go on the same body area.
quests.explanation: Socks and shoes are a foot-covering team. Socks go on first, then shoes.
quests.funFact: Wearing socks inside shoes helps them stay fresher and more comfortable.
